maddeler.e:
يتغرغر (form IIq)
# يَتَغَرْغَرُ (yataḡarḡaru) /ja.ta.ɣar.ɣa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَغَرْغَرَ (taḡarḡara)
# يَتَغَرْغَرَ (yataḡarḡara) /ja.ta.ɣar.ɣa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَغَرْغَرَ (taḡarḡara)
# يَتَغَرْغَرْ (yataḡarḡar) /ja.ta.ɣar.ɣar/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَغَرْغَرَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
